record.question: Lead apron minimum lead equivalence:
record.explanation: Answer B: 0.25mm Pb. AERB training material gives 0.25 mm lead equivalence for lead aprons; the question does not specify a different barrier/accessory type. Source/context note: AERB diagnostic-radiology training material specifies 0.25 mm Pb for lead aprons; apron thickness may vary by application. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
